note: R3.0E E3_OUTCOME_CLASSIFIER state. renderer/js/r3-0e-outcome-classifier.js is the authorized E3 production module: deterministic Outcome Classifier with closure-private WeakSet producer attestation. classifyOutcome(input, opts) accepts authoritative-only inputs (E1-valid Experiment + Applied Change record + Follow-up identity + Observation + Control Variable observations) and produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope registered in a module-private WeakSet. verifyAuthoritativeOutcome(candidate) is the only verifier exported. Classification enum (closed, mirrors E1 outcome-contract): confirmed / partially_confirmed / contradicted / inconclusive / invalid_comparison / inconclusive_due_to_confounders. Precedence ladder: invalid_comparison > inconclusive_due_to_confounders > inconclusive (data quality OR null direction) > contradicted (contradicting evidence OR direction mismatch) > partially_confirmed (direction match, magnitude outside range) > confirmed (only when direction match AND magnitude in expectedMagnitudeRange AND no contradictions AND no confounders AND same case/session AND explicit reference AND comparabilityScore >= 0.5). Clock invoked AT MOST ONCE, AFTER all authority/structural gates pass — forged input → zero clock invocations. Output never contains causal claims, driver-blame wording, raw telemetry samples, filesystem paths, or stack traces. uiAllowed + featureRegistryActivationAllowed remain false — UI surface is exclusively E5_UI_ACTIVATION. algorithmsAllowed=true ONLY for renderer/js/r3-0e-outcome-classifier.js (the exact authorized path in state.authorizedProductionPaths).
